sections.Profile:
The Wiggler , released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in 1967, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Ted Zale with artwork by Jerry Kelley.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1967
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Original Theme, Fantasy
